summary: Tested VHC Talent OS new features: Contact Form API, Admin Contact Submissions page, AI Search action buttons, and SEO meta tags. Backend APIs are working when MongoDB connection is stable. UI testing was interrupted by intermittent MongoDB Atlas SSL connection issues (TLSV1_ALERT_INTERNAL_ERROR).

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthenticated requests

integration_issues.issue: Login button shows loading spinner but doesn't complete when MongoDB has connection issues. No error toast displayed to user.

action_items: None - all requested features are properly implemented
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form API properly implemented with validation and MongoDB storage
Admin Contact Submissions page has proper View/Delete buttons and status filter
AI Search action buttons (View Full Profile, Add as Applicant) correctly implemented in FindCandidatesPage.jsx lines 435-450
SEO meta tags (og:title, og:description, twitter:card) present in all 8 static HTML files
Contact form on static site properly submits to /api/contact-submission with success/error handling
